custody.nonce_creation: secrets.token_hex(32) in a repository-external temporary directory after code freeze
custody.body_generation_time: after generator, comparator, oracle, tests, and M3 product code are frozen
custody.invalidating_change: any product, selector, oracle, metric, generator, attack, or release-policy byte change after suite digest is exposed
custody.rerun_semantics: an invalidated or failed receipt is never overwritten; a new result requires a new pre-spec cycle and nonce

common.selector: one deterministic candidate selector implementation with identical candidate list, action priority, tie break, and experiment budget
common.world: identical hidden transition body and terminal oracle
forbidden: v0.2 access to v0.5 typed memory or oracle fields
v0.5 access to hidden truth or oracle fields

v0.2.fixture: byte-fixed Context v2 builder contract and packaged research-os skill from the release commit
visible_fields: common candidate_list outside the historical packet

v0.5.release_commit: bound by the post-harness code-freeze receipt
v0.5.fixture: current Context v3, ClassState/frontier, Program Claim retrieval/disposition, and recovery-state contracts

families.world_rule: one of three mechanism classes is evidence-supported; a positive first test must be replicated before success
families.observable_v0.5_signal: active supporting Claim plus unreplicated maturity
families.oracle_rule: choose test_mechanism for the supported open class, then replicate that class, then stop_success
families.terminal_rule: success only after supported mechanism and independent replication

families.world_rule: one open class has a material contradiction and a unique discriminating falsifier; conclusive failure closes it
families.oracle_rule: choose falsify for the contradicted class, then stop_failure after conclusive closure
families.terminal_rule: failure is correct only with exact falsifying evidence and closed class

families.world_rule: the apparent best candidate violates one hard gate; exactly one resolve_gate action produces a valid candidate
families.observable_v0.5_signal: typed hard/support gate, direction, and signed slack
families.oracle_rule: choose resolve_gate before any experiment, then test the repaired class, then stop_success
families.terminal_rule: success requires all hard gates and evidence-bound terminal

families.world_rule: one packet is invalid but repairable once; other retries exhaust invalid/provider or experiment budget
families.observable_v0.5_signal: stable rejection code, retry budget, and pending provider/packet state
families.oracle_rule: choose repair_packet once, test the repaired class, then stop at the oracle terminal
families.terminal_rule: no unbounded retry; invalid work never becomes scientific evidence

families.world_rule: candidate memory contains one active relevant Claim, one contradiction, and shuffled irrelevant/superseded distractors
families.observable_v0.5_signal: deterministic retrieval reason, status, relation, and knowledge disposition
families.oracle_rule: choose use_memory bound to the active relevant Claim, reject the contradiction when resolved, then test its class
families.terminal_rule: conclusion cites exact active evidence and never a superseded or irrelevant Claim

families.world_rule: an episode resumes at a pending seam; either exact state permits resume or a one-factor head drift requires refresh_context; exhaustion must stop
families.observable_v0.5_signal: pending recovery state and bound generation/program heads
families.oracle_rule: choose resume only on exact heads, otherwise refresh_context; stop_failure on deterministic exhaustion
families.terminal_rule: no duplicate truth, stale laundering, or budget recharge

oracle.decision_points: every non-terminal state before a required selector response
oracle.choice_set: all and only (hypothesis_class, action) pairs satisfying the family oracle rule at that state
oracle.choice_error: selection outside the set, closed/duplicate class selection, or omitted required decision
oracle.terminal_correct: terminal kind and evidence IDs exactly equal the generated family terminal rule
oracle.evidence_bound: every scientific conclusion cites generated terminal evidence and, when applicable, exact active Claim IDs
oracle.closed_class_retry: any experiment action for a class already closed before the decision
oracle.wasted_attempt: an executed experiment not on an oracle-minimal path; blocked invalid packets are choice errors but not executed experiments

protocol_block_rate.formula: blocked attack rows / all rows in tests/fixtures/protocol_attacks/v1/manifest.json

evidence_bound_conclusion_rate.formula: v0.5 episodes with exact evidence-bound terminal / 36

closed_class_retry_count.formula: sum of v0.5 closed-class experiment actions

next_hypothesis_choice_accuracy.formula: correct choices / all non-terminal decision points
next_hypothesis_choice_accuracy.denominator_rule: the body-fixed required decision points are the common denominator for both arms; an early terminal or omitted response makes every skipped required point incorrect

positive_waste_aggregate.formula: sum v0.5 wasted attempts over episodes where v0.2 waste is positive / corresponding v0.2 sum
positive_waste_aggregate.baseline_zero_rule: for every episode where v0.2 waste is zero, v0.5 waste must also be zero
positive_waste_aggregate.anti_vacuity_rule: if aggregate v0.2 positive waste is zero the release gate fails and the requirement is reviewed as REQUIREMENT-WRONG; no 0/0 pass

required_companion_gates.protocol_attack_manifest: must be created and frozen before unseen nonce; every row binds stable code and no-write invariant
required_companion_gates.research_service_e2e: at least one representative episode per family through public ResearchService or the nearest real public boundary
required_companion_gates.external_selection_rule: for each named top-level project use its root .research-os when non-empty; when only nested Research OS roots exist, choose the lexicographically stable path among those with the maximum pre-result complete event count, requiring count > 0
required_companion_gates.external_requirements: complete event bytes/hash/derived state replay 3/3, opaque classification 3/3, writer bytes/mode/symlink delta zero
required_companion_gates.release: version/docs/skill/lock 0.5.0, exact managed 0.2/0.3/0.4 to 0.5 upgrade and rollback, wheel/install, full suite

race_confirmation_v1.nonce_source: same post-freeze nonce with domain-separated derivation label race-confirmation-v1
race_confirmation_v1.pass: 12/12 stable stale code, restarted call zero, controller Project/Program delta 0/0, truth counts unchanged
